# Question 1

```{r Feature Set}
set1 = c(
    "gestation_weeks",
    "mom_age",
    "mom_race_hispanic_status",
    "mom_educ")

set2 = c(    
    "mom_age",
    "mom_race_hispanic_status",
    "mom_educ",
    "gestation_weeks",
    "time",
    "in_hospital",
    "gestation_weeks"
    )

FS_1 = paste(
set1,
collapse = "+"
)

FS_2 = paste(
set2,
collapse = "+"
)

```

```{r}
# Label Train and Test Set 
training = Gsmall
testing = H
```

```{r Pre-allocate Results DF}
performance_df = 
  data.frame(
    Model = c("OLS","LASSO","RIDGE","ELASTIC NET"),
    Feature_set = c(rep("Small",4),rep("Medium",4),rep("Large",4)),
    `SD (Birthweight) In-sample` = c(rep(sd(Gsmall$birth_weight),12)),
    `SD (Birthweight) Out of Sample` = c(rep(sd(H$birth_weight),12)),
    `RMSE IS` = c(rep(NA_real_,12)),
    `RMSE CV` = c(rep(NA_real_,12)),
    `RMSE OOS` = c(rep(NA_real_,12)),
    lambda = c(rep(NA_real_,12)),
    alpha = c(rep(NA_real_,12)),
    check.names = F
  )

```

```{r OLS}

ols_function = function(outcome,
                        training,
                        testing,
                        FS_recipe
                        ){
## SD Y ------------------------------
is_sd_y = sd(training[[outcome]])
os_sd_y = sd(testing[[outcome]])
## Define Model ------------------------------
ols = linear_reg(
  mode = "regression",
  engine = "lm"
) 
## Define Workflow ------------------------------
ols_workflow = 
 workflow() %>% 
  add_model(ols) %>% 
  add_recipe(FS_recipe)

## Fit Model -------------------------------------
fit_ols =
  ols_workflow %>% 
  fit(data = training)

## Obtain Predictions ------------------------------
ols_oos = predict(fit_ols,testing)
  
# Calculate RMSE ------------------------------

## Combine Train-Test predictions and Outcomes into a DF 
ols_gof_train_df = data.frame(
  estimate = as.numeric(predict(fit_ols,training)$.pred),
  truth = unlist(fit_ols$pre$mold$outcomes[[outcome]]))

ols_gof_test_df = data.frame(
  estimate = as.numeric(ols_oos$.pred),
  truth = as.numeric(testing[[outcome]]))

## Calculate RMSE ------------------------------
ols_train_rmse = rmse(
     data = ols_gof_train_df,
     truth,
     estimate)

ols_test_rmse = rmse(
     data = ols_gof_test_df,
     truth,
     estimate)
# Return Items ------------------------------
return(
  data.frame(
    Model = "OLS",
    in_sample_sd_y = is_sd_y,
    oo_sample_sd_y = os_sd_y,
    in_sample_rmse = ols_train_rmse$.estimate,
    oo_sample_rmse = ols_test_rmse$.estimate,
    n_predictors = ncol(fit_ols$pre$mold$predictors)
  )
)
}

## Create Recipes 
FS_recipe_1 = recipe(as.formula(paste0("birth_weight","~",FS_1)), 
         data = training) %>%
         step_zv()

FS_recipe_2 = recipe(as.formula(paste0("birth_weight","~",FS_2)), 
         data = training) %>%
  step_mutate(
    across(c(
   # mom_age,
   # mom_race_hispanic_status,
   # mom_educ,
    gestation_weeks
    #time
    ), 
    as.factor)
  ) %>% 
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(),
             one_hot = T) %>% 
  step_zv(all_predictors())

# Run OLS Function on feature sets 
ols_fs_1 = ols_function("birth_weight",
    FS_recipe = FS_recipe_1,
    training = training,
    testing = testing)

ols_fs_2 = ols_function("birth_weight",
    FS_recipe = FS_recipe_2,
    training = training,
    testing = testing) 

### Save Metrics ###

rbind(ols_fs_1,
      ols_fs_2)
# why are these not chnaging? hmm 
```
